name: Lai Wong
source:
Captain Lai Wong, the commanding officer of the technical portion of the base where the sabotage is occuring and next in command after [url=https://vndb.org/c14804]Commander Carla Benedict[/url], is an extremely haughty person and she is proud of her Chinese heritage. She also has a superiority complex and hates being overshadowed by anyone for any reason. Being a difficult person to deal with doesn't make her an automatic suspect, but her complete knowledge of the base operations means she mustn't be overlooked by [url=https://vndb.org/c14801]Captain Leiji[/url].

[Edited from [url=http://engbishoujo.tripod.com/criticalprofiles.html]Game's Manual[/url] and [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/562753-critical-point/faqs/19503]Ben Woodhouse's Walkthrough[/url]]
